full_page.content:
Page 138 Cont.
July 2nd Mary McCann - 19 - strep - glands - sickly and sick since seven. Her aunt, Nelly Welsh, teaches, ordered the four books, "City of God" promising they would read them if niece were spared.
5th Cyril J. Lefevre - 17 - Spinal manengitis - blood clot - Enemic - complication - slowly improving ... in oxegin
Marian Hoban - 65 - lost a leg 12 yrs. ago; lost husband six yrs. and now in Receiving Hosp. with diabetis and another double fractured leg.
5 George White - 24 - nerveous - mental trouble - Mother asks for PP.
Arlen Meldrum - 12 - big for 14 - received hip bruse and from it T.B. of bone - in cast most of time for four yrs. Was to have new cast To-day - Tomorrow. Starts perpetual enrollment To-day.
Page 139 July 5th Girard Naumann - 24 - keeping company with person insane .... Thanks - Eugene Sellers - 40 - of Crescent Pa. - has stopped drinking. Thomas Johnson - 58 - fire cracker in face yesterday ..
July 4 Eva St. Ours - 38 - of Escanaba, Mich. - - cured of blindness. One eye completely blind - the other almost gone. Enrolled in S.M.A. and made novena to Sacred Heart - Completely cured that day - Sight 100%
S. Gerald O'Doherty - 13 - stafe type of strep poison ... seeming fatal. . ..
Barbara Ann Strzelewicz - 2'2 - slight form of infantile paralysis
Thanks - James H. Rae - 38 - Methodest - hopeless in Ann Arbor Hospi- tal when on May - he was enrolled in Ser. Mass Ass'n. Here To-day Okay .
Page 140 July 9
Marg. E. Sheridan - 63 - given up as hopeless last Friday with fuptured apendix. Enrolled when supposed to be dying .... now out of danger
Judith Gallagher - 60 - threatened with cancer of womb. ..
